mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GROUP_DEAL_QNA ( qna_id, group_deal_id, parent_id, user_id, title, content, is_private, status, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( SEQ_GROUP_DEAL_QNA.NEXTVAL, #{groupDealId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{isPrivate}, #{status}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT qna_id AS qnaId, group_deal_id AS groupDealId, parent_id AS parentId, user_id AS userId, title, content, is_private AS isPrivate, status, responder_id AS responderId, answer_content AS answerContent, answered_at AS answeredAt, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM GROUP_DEAL_QNA WHERE group_deal_id = #{groupDealId} ORDER BY created_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE GROUP_DEAL_QNA SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_private = #{isPrivate}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE qna_id = #{qnaId}
